title: Here’s How You Tax the Billionaires
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
Will billionaires like Jeff Bezos and Elon Musk ever
[pay](https://www.propublica.org/article/the-secret-irs-files-trove-of-never-
before-seen-records-reveal-how-the-wealthiest-avoid-income-tax) their fair
share of taxes? Or are they just destined to find loophole after loophole, as
they [bury](https://fortune.com/2026/06/23/elon-musk-trillionaire-paper-
wealth-spacex-tesla-exposed-failure/) their massive wealth in illiquid stocks
and shares?

In this '**Mehdi Unfiltered** ' interview, world-renowned expert on tax
avoidance and wealth inequality, economist **Gabriel Zucman,** explains to
**Mehdi** why a wealth tax may be the perfect response to billionaires' shady
tax tricks.

**" People like Elon Musk or Jeff Bezos in some years [were] reporting no
income and paying no income tax," **says**** Zucman, who is also an economics
professor at UC Berkeley and the Paris School of Economics. "**That 's why if
you want to ensure that the super rich pay their fair share, you have to go
after wealth itself."**

In the interview, Zucman debunks arguments against a wealth tax and explains
why such a measure is so urgent right now, on both sides of the Atlantic.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

He and Mehdi also discuss:

  * California's impending vote on [Proposition 40](https://www.npr.org/2026/08/20/nx-s1-5935597/california-billionaires-wealth-tax-sergey-brin), which would implement a one-time 5% wealth tax on the state's billionaires

  * How billionaires like [Musk](https://zeteo.com/p/elon-musk-trillionaire-klein) and [Bezos](https://zeteo.com/p/washington-post-jeff-bezos-editorial-board-wealth-tax?utm_source=publication-search) benefit from hoarding their wealth into their holding companies

  * Why billionaire entrepreneur [Mark Cuban](https://fortune.com/2026/08/17/mark-cuban-california-billionaires-tax-wealth-ro-khanna/) and California Governor [Gavin Newsom](https://www.cnn.com/2026/06/26/politics/gavin-newsom-billionaire-tax-california) are wrong to argue that a wealth tax will drive away business

  * Whether the UK's new Labour Prime Minister [Andy Burnham](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c89nww3z99po) should consider a wealth tax

  * Why some wealth taxes have failed in other countries, like [France](https://www.reuters.com/article/world/macron-fights-president-of-the-rich-tag-after-ending-wealth-tax-idUSKCN1C82DF/)
